verdict.rationale: EFTPS documents a sanctioned third-party rail. Tax professionals can make payments for multiple clients under a single login through the Batch Provider program and its software. The service also directs taxpayers to a tax professional or payroll provider to make payments on their behalf, and it addresses authenticating across multiple enrollments. Missing for 10: documentation of how a company formally authorizes or revokes a provider (designee or enrollment linkage), scope limits on provider actions, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
